articles.title: England Swelters Through Record-Breaking Heatwave, Straining Health Services and Transport
articles.summary: The UK’s third heatwave of 2026 pushed temperatures to 35.1°C, breaking the record for most 34°C+ days in a year. Amber health alerts now cover nearly all of England, with ambulance services under “sustained pressure.” Rail disruptions are widespread as tracks risk buckling.

articles.title: Ex-Olympian Pleads Not Guilty in Reflecting Pool Vandalism Case, Calling It a Political Stunt
articles.summary: David Hearn, a 67-year-old former Olympic canoeist, pleaded not guilty to damaging the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. Prosecutors allege he caused over $1,000 in damage to the recently renovated pool. Hearn claims he merely touched the water, and his supporters argue he’s a scapegoat for a botched $14 million project.

articles.title: Trump’s 250-Foot Arch Faces Federal Pushback Over D.C. Height Limits
articles.summary: A federal planning commission says Trump’s proposed 250-foot arch near the Lincoln Memorial violates the Height of Buildings Act. Staff recommend design tweaks, but the arch could still reach its full height.
